svg.title: 8-bit typing racer game mockup, version 2
svg.desc: Portrait game screen with a menu icon at top left, the score centered at top, and difficulty at top right. A red car in the middle lane has flashing skid marks. Two word boxes at the bottom each pair a direction arrow with a steering wheel.
